description: Agronomic Crop Rotation & Compatibility Parameters for AgroIntel Phase 4 Engine

monoculture_repetition_penalty.description: Penalty multiplier applied when repeating the exact same crop in consecutive seasons (e.g. Rice -> Rice).
monoculture_repetition_penalty.agronomic_justification: Monoculture leads to rapid soil nutrient depletion (especially N and K), host-specific pest buildup (e.g. stem borer), and soil pathogen accumulation.
monoculture_repetition_penalty.source_reference: ICAR Handbook of Agriculture & TNAU Agronomic Rotation Guidelines

same_family_repetition_penalty.description: Penalty multiplier applied when planting a crop from the same botanical family in consecutive seasons (e.g. Poaceae -> Poaceae).
same_family_repetition_penalty.agronomic_justification: Crops in the same botanical family share similar nutrient extraction profiles and insect pest/fungal disease susceptibilities.
same_family_repetition_penalty.source_reference: FAO Crop Rotation & Soil Health Guidelines

legume_rotation_bonus.description: Bonus multiplier applied when a legume/pulse crop (Fabaceae) follows a heavy cereal nitrogen feeder (Poaceae).
legume_rotation_bonus.agronomic_justification: Legumes fix atmospheric nitrogen via Rhizobium symbiosis (20-40 kg N/ha residual), improving soil structure and organic matter.
legume_rotation_bonus.source_reference: ICAR-Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) Rotation Guidelines

deep_root_rotation_bonus.description: Bonus multiplier applied when alternating shallow-rooted crops with deep-rooted taproot crops.
deep_root_rotation_bonus.agronomic_justification: Breaks hardpan compaction, extracts subsoil nutrients, and improves water infiltration.

short_duration_window_bonus.description: Bonus multiplier for short-duration crops (<=120 days) fitting tight seasonal windows.
short_duration_window_bonus.agronomic_justification: Allows double/triple cropping without exposing crops to end-of-season drought or frost risks.
short_duration_window_bonus.source_reference: State Agricultural University Cropping System Bulletins

exceed_duration_window_penalty.description: Severe penalty multiplier applied when candidate crop duration exceeds the remaining seasonal window.
exceed_duration_window_penalty.agronomic_justification: Crops extending beyond seasonal moisture/temperature boundaries suffer severe yield loss or total crop failure.
